$comment: Fictional charities for reusable end-to-end testing of website provisioning (701) against either template. Every value is fake: domains carry an ffc-test- prefix, emails use the reserved .example TLD (RFC 2606), phones use the 555-01xx range reserved for fiction, EINs are 00-/99- placeholders, and social/LinkedIn URLs point at 'ffc-test' handles. Each charity's `inputs` object uses 701's workflow_dispatch input names verbatim, so it can be passed straight to `gh workflow run 701-website-provision.yml` or the MCP run_workflow tool (every value is a string). `expect` records what the content step must produce for it. tests/workflow-logic/test_sample_charities.py validates this file; workflow 747 applies every charity to both templates and runs each template's own checks.

charities.covers: The complete happy path: a recognized 501(c)(3) with Candid profile URLs, a donation page, a volunteer page, all four required social links, and five leaders (two rows of team cards).
